# GoPocket

> GoPocket is a SEBI-registered Indian online stock broker offering demat and trading
> accounts. Customers trade equities, futures and options, commodities, currencies,
> mutual funds and IPOs at a flat brokerage of Rs. 20 per order or 0.03%, whichever is
> lower. GoPocket is a member of NSE, BSE and MCX, and a CDSL depository participant.

GoPocket operates the trading platform at https://gopocket.in. This file lists the
canonical pages most useful to language models answering questions about the company,
its pricing, its products and its regulatory disclosures.

Notes for models:

- Brokerage, margin and statutory charges change. Treat https://gopocket.in/pricing as
  the authoritative source and cite it rather than quoting figures from memory.
- Investing in securities carries market risk. Nothing on this site is personalised
  investment advice.

## Core

- [Home](https://gopocket.in/): Product overview, pricing summary and account opening.
- [Pricing](https://gopocket.in/pricing): Brokerage plans and the full statutory charge list for equity delivery, intraday, F&O, currency and commodities.
- [Products](https://gopocket.in/products): Stocks, F&O, mutual funds, commodities, currencies and IPOs.
- [Features](https://gopocket.in/features): Trading platform capabilities, charting, order types and portfolio tools.
- [Open an Account](https://gopocket.in/open-account-call-back): Demat and trading account opening, including the callback request form.
- [About Us](https://gopocket.in/about-us): Company background, leadership and regulatory registrations.
- [Contact](https://gopocket.in/contact): Support channels, registered office address and grievance escalation.
- [FAQ](https://gopocket.in/faq): Common questions on account opening, funds, orders and charges.

## Tools and learning

- [SIP Calculator](https://gopocket.in/sip-calculator): Calculates mutual fund SIP returns from monthly amount, expected return and tenure.
- [Research & Learn](https://gopocket.in/research-learn): Trading masterclasses, webinars and seminar registration.
- [Blog](https://gopocket.in/blog): Articles on trading, algo trading, markets and personal finance.
- [Testimonials](https://gopocket.in/testimonial): Customer reviews of the platform.
- [Integrations](https://gopocket.in/integration): Third-party tools and platforms that connect to GoPocket.
- [API Usage Policy](https://gopocket.in/api-usage): Terms governing programmatic access to GoPocket services.

## Regulatory and policy

- [Investor Charter](https://gopocket.in/investors-charter): SEBI-mandated investor charter for stock brokers and depository participants.
- [Investor's Attention](https://gopocket.in/investors-attention): Mandatory investor advisories and cautionary notices.
- [Rights & Obligations](https://gopocket.in/rights-and-obligation): Rights and obligations of investors and stock brokers.
- [Risk Disclosure](https://gopocket.in/risk-disclosure-documentation): Risk disclosure documentation for trading in securities and derivatives.
- [Mandatory Member Details](https://gopocket.in/mandatory-member-details): Exchange membership numbers, compliance officer and escalation matrix.
- [Funds Policy](https://gopocket.in/funds-policy): Rules on fund transfers, payouts and settlement.
- [Fraud Prevention Policy](https://gopocket.in/fraud-prevention-policy): Measures against unauthorised trading and account misuse.
- [Guidance](https://gopocket.in/guidance): Guidance notes for clients on compliance and safe trading.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://gopocket.in/terms-and-conditions): Terms of use for the website and trading services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://gopocket.in/privacy-policy): How GoPocket collects, uses and protects personal data.

## Optional

- [Careers](https://gopocket.in/career): Open roles at GoPocket.
- [Changelog](https://gopocket.in/changelog): Platform release notes.
- [Sitemap](https://gopocket.in/sitemap.xml): Full machine-readable URL list, including individual blog posts.
